dict.string: nightjar-hack listens for Bluetooth devices around you and logs what it hears. If you use the Send tab, it can also advertise a payload you type and write to devices you choose. Listening never connects to anything.
nightjar-hack sends payloads to, and receives payloads from, devices on your local network — only to addresses you type, and only while the app is open.

nightjar-hack listens for Chirp transmissions — short messages another of your devices sends as audible tones — only while you hold the Chirp listener open in the Knocktalk tab. Nothing is recorded or stored; tones are decoded in the moment and forgotten.
